about: [O6b critic] the parts as things, poked: the door and bonnet lying in the lane (&ten=parts): walk into the door, stand on it, E at it; look at it close; then the car over both at speed, and a look back at where they went.

steps.name: walk into the door lying
steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return [[d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 3], [d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z - 2]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return JSON.stringify({me:[N.controller.pos.x,N.controller.pos.y,N.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), door:[d.body.p.x,d.body.p.y,d.body.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), st:d.state, t:[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent&&e.children.length===0&&e.innerText&&e.innerText.trim()).map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,50)).join(' | ')}); })()
